nodes.description: Private _transfer: applies fees, blacklist/cooldown checks, maxWallet limit, and triggers swap/ETH distribution to fee addresses mid-transfer.
Private swapTokensForEth: builds path, approves router and calls swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens on the external Uniswap router.
Private sendETHToFee: splits contract ETH balance and pushes it to _FeeAddress and _FeeAddress2 via transfer.
Private _tokenTransfer: selects reflection/token transfer variant and handles fee removal/restoration.
Owner-only addLiquidity: creates Uniswap pair, approves it and adds liquidity with ETH, initializing trading parameters.
Owner-only openTrading: sets tradingOpen flag and buy limit window based on block.timestamp.
External manualswap: gated only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress, swaps the whole contract token balance.
External manualsend: gated only by _msgSender() == _FeeAddress, sends entire ETH balance to fee addresses.
External addBotToBlackList: restricted to _FeeAddress, adds an arbitrary account to the bot blacklist.
External removeBotFromBlackList: restricted to _FeeAddress, removes an account from the bot blacklist.
Owner-only updateMaxWalletAmount: enforces a floor and multiplies the new limit by 1e9 into maxWallet.
Owner-only excludeAccount: converts reflection balance to token balance and marks the account as excluded.
Owner-only includeAccount: removes an account from the excluded list and resets its token balance.
Public ERC20 transfer: forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public transferFrom: moves tokens and decrements allowance of _msgSender().
Public approve: writes the allowance mapping via _approve.
Public renounceOwnership guarded by onlyOwner: clears the owner address.
Owner-only setExcludeFromFee: toggles fee exemption for an arbitrary account.
Owner-only setCooldownEnabled: toggles the buy cooldown feature.
View timeToBuy: derives a time delta from block.timestamp and stored cooldown data.
Private _takeTeam: mints reflection share to the contract address.
Private _reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and accrues _tFeeTotal.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used for blacklist and cooldown state checks inside _transfer, letting the caller influence transfer gating.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the token sender to _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance check and decrement.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
manualswap privilege is checked only against the caller's address, not against owner state.
manualsend privilege is checked only against the caller's address, not against owner state.
addBotToBlackList authorization relies solely on msg.sender equality with _FeeAddress.
removeBotFromBlackList authorization relies solely on msg.sender equality with _FeeAddress.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to the owner.
block.timestamp drives buyLimitEnd and cooldown comparisons, making buy restrictions time dependent.
openTrading computes the buy limit window from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline and stores it as launch time.
timeToBuy returns block.timestamp minus the stored buy timestamp, exposing timing dependency.
block.timestamp is written into buyLimitEnd, the bound controlling the buy cooldown window.
block.timestamp is used in the cooldown timestamp arithmetic that gates purchases.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external swap before all transfer bookkeeping completes.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out while the transfer is still executing.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external Uniswap router to swap tokens for ETH.
ETH transfer to a fee address is an external value call that can re-enter the contract.
manualswap can be invoked by the fee address and triggers the external swap path.
manualsend drains the ETH balance through the external fee transfer path.
